text: Level three, question six: a leak in the bottom of a tank can empty the full tank in ten hours; an inlet tap that admits six litres a minute is opened, and the full tank now empties in twelve hours; find the capacity of the tank. Question seven: a cistern has an inlet that fills it in six hours and a leak that empties it in twelve hours; a tap that draws ten litres a minute is also open; with all three, the empty cistern fills in twenty hours; find its capacity. Question eight: a pipe normally fills a tank in six hours; when the tank was half full, a leak developed, and the tank took one hour longer than usual to fill; how long would the leak alone take to empty the full tank?
